'''Yarua''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] elder [[Politics/Legends|statesman]] who [[Senator/Legends|represented]] [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Yarua [[Kashyyyk Senatorial Delegation|delegation]] was assisted by two Wookiee aides and, at the end of his career, Yarua had at least 100 years in his senatorial place. Following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Yarua was arrested and removed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
[[File:Yarua_and_Palpatine.png|thumb|left|Senator Yarua with his colleague Palpatine during the waning years of the Old Republic.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Yarua originated from the arboreal [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. In his younger [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Yarua only wished to work in the family business and prepare for taking its leadership in due time. But events went out of control: at the age of 120, Yarua was forced to take the mantle of patriarch when his father died in an accident. The Wookiee took his new role with profound importance, learning to deal with conflicts by using diplomacy rather than brute force. He emerged as a capable [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]], and the [[Wookiee Chieftain|elders]] of his community came to admire him. Around [[119 BBY]], when the Wookiee [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented his people before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] retired, the elders urged Yarua to succeed him. The young patriarch accepted the honor his peers did him and traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the Republic.<ref name="SK" />

Yarua was one of the senators who supported [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] [[Yinchorri embargo act|sanctions]] against the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="JC4">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 4|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 4]]</ref> Later that year, Chancellor Valorum proposed the taxation of the until then free trade zones. Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] then suggested that a part of the collected money could be invested in the growth of planetary systems in the affected areas. Yarua and other Senators of the region, including [[Tendau Bendon/Legends|Tendau Bendon]] and [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]], cheerfully supported the idea.<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], several peace negotiation meetings between the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] took place on [[Hsskhor/Legends|Hsskhor]], but none reached profitable results. Senator Yarua and Trandoshan [[Speaker-Above-All]] [[Hadocrassk]] met up with the diplomat [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], trying to find peace between the two cultures.<ref name="HNN48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_1.html|Kashyyyk/Trandoshan Talks to Shaky Start}}</ref> Unfortunately, serious attacks from the Trandoshans against the Wookiees, including the destruction of a transport with 215 Wookiees, made it almost impossible. The negotiations finally stopped when it was learned that the Trandoshans had support from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and finally declared themselves as Republican opponents.<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|regional/1344_1.html|Kashyyyk / Trandoshan Talks Break Down}}</ref> Yarua stayed on the Republic's side by his [[Grakchawwaa/Legends|King's]] because of his natural sympathy for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic itself.

Following the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], Yarua and the other members of the [[Kashyyyk Senatorial Delegation]] were arrested and removed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], because Kashyyyk was actively aiding to hide [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="DL:RoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:YaruaDroid.jpg|thumb|Yarua disagrees with his interpreter droid.]]
Despite his attachment to diplomacy,<ref name="SK" /> Yarua still had the fiery temper of most Wookiees, and he would sometimes give way to anger. When he withdrew his delegation from the negotiations with the Trandoshans in 22 BBY, Yarua destroyed the protocol droid translating the talks by pulling the interpreter's right arm out of its socket.<ref name="HNN50" /> Nonetheless, Senator Yarua possessed a firm sense of fairness and was known as a forceful champion of justice in the Senate. In the halls of the Senate Rotunda, his imposing stature and fierce attitude inspired reverent awe among his peers.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Original Trilogy Collection|packtype='05 Basic Figure|pack=#02: Yarua (Coruscant Senate)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw0502yarua.asp}}</ref>

Yarua of Kashyyyk despised the rampant corruption around him, and he found representation of commercial power within the Senate scandalous.<ref name="SWV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Although his fondest wish was to return to the peace and tranquillity of his homeworld, the Wookiee was bent on seeing his responsibilities through to the end. Throughout his career, Yarua was a enthusiastic supporter of the Republican reform movements,<ref name="SK" /> which he thought could be funded by a thorough taxation plan.<ref name="CCG Cor">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Yarua}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Yarua first appeared in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''Star Wars'' [[prequel trilogy]], in which he was played by [[John Coppinger]].

Because of the Italian Hasbro comic story [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (comic)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'']] requiring that they implement images from Hasbro's FlashBack Photos franchise into the story for marketing purposes, it gave the, albeit forced, first implication that Palpatine, back when he was a senator, initially had good relations to the Wookiees in spite of his Empire's speciesist policies. The implementation of this led to some confusion, which had been noted in the [[Star Wars Insider 96]] article [[Strangers Among Us: The Aliens Who Built the Galactic Empire|Strangers Among Us]], although the specific details were later supplied in both the story [[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'']] as well as in the 2001 political thriller ''[[Cloak of Deception]]''.<ref name="Forza">{{SW|url=news/hasbro-italys-mysterious-star-wars-comic-il-potere-della-forza|text=Hasbro Italy's Mysterious Star Wars Comic, Il Potere della Forza|nolive=1}}</ref>
